detailed_description: The JSON to Java tool generates simple Java class code from a JSON object. Paste a valid JSON object, set the class name and optional package name, then choose whether to generate getters and setters or use Lombok annotations. Nested objects can produce additional classes, and arrays are mapped to list-style fields based on their first item. The generated code is intended as a starting point for DTOs or examples and may need manual review for annotations, validation rules, naming conventions, and project-specific serialization requirements.
usage_steps: Paste a valid JSON object into the input text area.
Set the Java class name and optional package name.
Choose whether to use Lombok, getters and setters, or a Lombok builder.
Click Convert to generate Java code.
Review the output and any nested classes.
Use Copy to copy the generated Java code.
usage_examples: Generate a starter Java DTO from a sample API response object.
Create a class with getters and setters for a small JSON fixture.
Enable Lombok to reduce boilerplate in generated example code.
Review nested generated classes before adapting them to a project.
